svg.title: Understory system architecture
svg.desc: Proposed web and MCP request paths, durable PostgreSQL worker indexing, grounded retrieval, and atomic snapshot publication.
svg.text: Code understanding + contribution research, backed by versioned evidence
A shared API for the web workspace and future agent tools
One database for content, job state and progress
Local worker; pinned sources; no code execution
Pinned code + docs at a SHA
Solid arrows: requests / data Dashed arrows: control or future integration
Job state and content share PostgreSQL. Code snapshots and discussion observations have separate version boundaries.
